title: Build a word-count CLI
prompt: Create a Node CLI `wc.js` that reads a file path from `process.argv[2]`, reads that file, and prints exactly three space-separated numbers followed by a newline: `<lines> <words> <bytes>` (like `wc`). Lines = number of newline characters. Words = whitespace-separated tokens. Bytes = byte length of the file. If no path is given or the file is missing, print an error to stderr and exit with code 1. There is a `verify.test.js` that spawns your CLI on a sample file and checks the output; make `node --test verify.test.js` pass. Do NOT modify the test file or `sample.txt`.
